headline: A tiny open source browser agent using Jev instead of an LLM for every click.

media.alt: Video from the post by CyrilXBT

text:
A tiny open source browser agent using Jev instead of an LLM for every click.

Found a flight search in 7 SECONDS.

Total cost: $0.0039.

Here's why that's not a typo.

A normal browser agent asks a chat model "what should I click" on every single step. That's a full generation…
